publications.name: SNU-Avatar Haptic Glove: Novel Modularized Haptic Glove via Trigonometric Series Elastic Actuators
publications.publisher: 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
publications.summary: This research develops a haptic glove for realistic avatar-robot teleoperation, integrating Trigonometric SEA–based finger force feedback and a stable middle-phalanx attachment design. A fingertip-position estimation algorithm enables accurate hand-posture sensing without fingertip sensors, improving usability and comfort. The system was validated in the ANA Avatar XPRIZE, successfully completing missions involving object manipulation and social interaction.

publications.name: SNU-Avatar Robot Hand: Dexterous Robot Hand with Prismatic Four-Bar Linkage for Versatile Daily Applications
publications.publisher: 2023 IEEE-RAS 22nd International Conference on Humanoid Robots
publications.summary: This research presents a robot hand designed for the ANA Avatar XPRIZE, enabling realistic teleoperation through the replication of human actions, gestures, and everyday object manipulation. Using multi–4-bar linkages for single-actuator flexion–extension and compliant AA joints for adaptive grasping, a lightweight four-finger, eight-DoF hand with strong fingertip grip was achieved. The paper outlines the kinematic design, FEM-based structural validation, and taxonomy analysis from real grasping experiments.
